declaration: 4GL section: declare tables, domains, and variables for the script.
functions: 4GL section: local functions used by the UI or report script.
before.program: 4GL program event: runs once when the session starts.
after.program: 4GL program event: runs when the session ends.
on.error: 4GL program event: handles runtime errors for the session.
init.form: 4GL form event: initialize the form when it is first shown.
init.group: 4GL group event: initialize a form group.
selection.filter: 4GL field event: restrict zoom/selection query for the field.
before.save.object: DAL2 hook: validate or prepare data before saving an object.
after.save.object: DAL2 hook: runs after an object was saved successfully.
before.new.object: 4GL program event: runs before a new object is created in the UI session.
after.new.object: 4GL program event: runs after a new object is created in the UI session.
before.destroy.object: DAL2 hook: runs before deleting an object.
after.destroy.object: DAL2 hook: runs after an object was deleted.
before.get.object: DAL2 hook: runs before reading an object.
after.get.object: DAL2 hook: runs after an object was read.
set.object.defaults: DAL2 hook: assign default field values for a new object.
method.is.allowed: DAL2 hook: decide whether a DAL method is allowed.
dal.new.object: DAL1: start creating a new business object by table name.
dal.change.object: DAL1: start changing an existing business object.
dal.save.object: DAL1: save the current DAL1 object; returns 0 on success.
dal.destroy.object: DAL1: delete the current DAL1 object.
dal.set.field: DAL1: set a field value on the current object (table.field, value).
dal.new: Create a new DAL object instance in memory.
dal.update: Write pending DAL object changes to the database.
dal.get.error.message: Read the last DAL error message text.
message: Show a message dialog or status message to the user.
mess: Show a coded/library message to the user.
zoom.to$: Open another session (zoom) and optionally return a value.
set.input.error: Mark the current field input as invalid and show an error.
db.retry.point: Mark a database retry point for locked-row retries.
db.insert: Insert the current table buffer row into the database.
db.update: Update the current table buffer row in the database.
db.delete: Delete the current table buffer row from the database.
db.eq: Position on a table row matching the current key values.
db.first: Move to the first row of the current table/set.
db.next: Move to the next row of the current table/set.
db.prev: Move to the previous row of the current table/set.
db.last: Move to the last row of the current table/set.
db.error: Return the last database error code for the process.
db.error.message: Return the text for the last database error.
db.set.to.default: Fill the table buffer with domain default values.
abort.transaction: Roll back the open database transaction.
selectdo: Embedded SQL: body executed for each selected row.
selectempty: Embedded SQL: runs when the select returned no rows.
endselect: Embedded SQL: ends a select / selectdo block.
rprt_open: Open the report device for a print session.
rprt_send: Send the current report line/record to the print device.
execute: Run a standard choice/command (for example print.data).
choice.again: Re-prompt or re-run the previous choice flow.
get.screen.defaults: Load screen default values for range fields.
display: Refresh displayed fields on the form.
len: Return the length of a string.
pos: Find the position of a substring within a string.
strip$: Trim trailing spaces from a string.
str$: Convert a number to a string.
shiftl$: Shift a string left (pad/truncate on the right).
shiftr$: Shift a string right (pad/truncate on the left).
date.num: Return today's date as a LN date number.
date.to.num: Convert a date value to a LN date number.
num.to.date$: Format a LN date number as a date string.
stpapi.put.field: API: put a field value into an open synchronized session.
stpapi.get.field: API: read a field value from an open synchronized session.
stpapi.insert: API: insert via an open synchronized session.
stpapi.update: API: update via an open synchronized session.
stpapi.find: API: find a row via an open synchronized session.
stpapi.save: API: save via an open synchronized session.
query.extend.where: Extend the session query WHERE clause.
attr.changed: Indicates if the current field has changed.
on case: 3GL multiple-way decision: ON CASE expr / CASE n: / DEFAULT: / ENDCASE; use break to skip remaining CASE labels.
default: 3GL ON CASE: optional branch when no CASE expression matches.
break: Exit the innermost loop or stop evaluating same-level ON CASE labels.
continue: Skip to the next iteration of the innermost WHILE/FOR/REPEAT loop.
elif: Shorthand for ELSE IF cond THEN without an extra ENDIF (TIV 2330+).
db.retry: Lock/retry mode constant often passed to db.insert / db.update.
EFNAME: 114 EFNAME — Index could not be created
EROWCHANGED: 201 EROWCHANGED — Row changed by other user
ENOTINRANGE: 205 ENOTINRANGE — Value is out of range
EMLOCKED: 210 EMLOCKED — Record in mirroring is locked
ETRANSACTIONOPEN: 213 ETRANSACTIONOPEN — Transaction is started, but not updated
EUNALLOWEDCOMPNR: 214 EUNALLOWEDCOMPNR — Operation not allowed for a logical company
EAUDCORRUPT: 252 EAUDCORRUPT — An audit file is corrupt
EAUDLOCKED: 253 EAUDLOCKED — An audit file is locked
EAUDABORT: 254 EAUDABORT — Commit transaction on the audit server has failed.
EEXTENSIONHOOKERROR: 299 EEXTENSIONHOOKERROR — Error raised by hook in extension
ESQLSYNTAX: 302 ESQLSYNTAX — Syntax error in SQL statement
ESQLINDEXOUTOFDIMS: 308 ESQLINDEXOUTOFDIMS — Array column index out of range
ESQLCARDINALITYVIOLATION: 310 ESQLCARDINALITYVIOLATION — SQL subquery (with comparison) returns more than 1 row
EBDBON: 502 EBDBON — User already logged in to database
EBDBNOTON: 508 EBDBNOTON — Not logged on to a database
ELICENSEERROR: 515 ELICENSEERROR — License error or corrupt shared memory
EDELAYED: 517 EDELAYED — General error for delayed locking
EBDBDBCONNECTIONLOST: 522 EBDBDBCONNECTIONLOST — Connection to the database has been lost
EREFEXISTS: 605 EREFEXISTS — Delete failed due to reference

attr.bitset.mask: In general: bitsets are deprecated in the UI. The available values for a bitset field (see also Enumerates overview and synopsis). (deprecated)
attr.deflt$: Default value of current field. When the TIV level is less than 2040, then the length of this string is 100.
attr.diga: Number of digits after decimal sign. For strings, this is the maximum input length.
attr.digv: Number of digits before decimal sign.
attr.divf: Division factor. (For entering numeric values without a decimal point.)
attr.domm$: Domain message code of current field.
attr.dorp: Fill field with default or previous value: DORP.PREVIOUS (0)
attr.element: Current array index (if field is an array element).
attr.enum.mask$: The values available for an enumerate field. Also the enumerate values available for the ask.enum() function. See also set.enum.values.for.field() function. (deprecated)
attr.format.addition$: Currency to be used for an amount format. Language to be used for a date format.
attr.maxlen: Maximum display length of current field. (deprecated)
attr.message$: Message to be displayed when a field is filled after a before.input event.
attr.nowait$: Characters that start a field command. This variable is supported for backward compatibility only. In Infor Enterprise Server, field command functionality is replaced by form commands. (deprecated)
attr.rang$: Defines a range; values are automatically checked against this range.
attr.rotate: Current index in currency table (see set.currencies() function).
attr.textfield$: Name of the text field. Used by the Text Manager.
attr.textkw1$: Keywords of text. Used by the Text Manager. The output string is multi-byte.
attr.textlang$: Language for text editing. Used by the Text Manager.
attr.textmaxlines: Maximum number of lines in the text editor. Used by the Text Manager.
attr.textopt$: Name of default option for editor window options. Used by the Text Manager.
attr.textzoomsession$: Session zoomed to by text editor zoom command. The default is "Display Texts" session. Used by the Text Manager.
attr.type: Database type (DB.ENUM, DB.STRING, DB.TIME, DB.DATE, and so on)
attr.zoomindex: Number of table-index to start session zoomed to from a field.
attr.zoomreturn$: Name of return field of zoom session on current field.
curr.key: Current key number of main table. Not available in before.program.
e: Error code of last file action.
fattr.helpfile$: Name of help file for current form. (deprecated)
fattr.init: Indicates if the form has been initialized.
fattr.nrtabs: Number of tabs on current form (dynamic forms only).
fattr.occurnr: Number of occurrences on current form.
fattr.seqno: Sequence number of current field in form. (deprecated)
fattr.toplines: The number of lines above the multioccurrence fields (default: 3). Set in the before.program section. (deprecated)
fattr.total.line: If set in before.program section, this indicates that a total line must be displayed in the grid (see also display.total.fields()). Can have the values true or false.
form.next: Next form number. -1 if no next form
form.prev: Previous form number. -1 if no previous form
lattr.autobefores: A boolean indicating whether or not before.field layouts are automatically repeated at the top of a page if the page break does not correspond with a sort break. The default value is true. (R/W)
lattr.autoreset: A boolean indicating whether or not Report script functions is automatically performed in the case of breaks of layouts in sorting fields. The default value is true. (R/W)
lattr.break: A boolean that is set to true during printing of before.field layouts when the layout is printed as the result of a sort field change. It is set to false when a before.field layout is printed because of a page break. (R)
lattr.enddata: A boolean indicating whether or not the end of the data has been reached. (R)
lattr.header: A boolean that is set to true during printing of header layouts and during printing of before.field layouts at the top of a page. (R)
lattr.language$: The language code of the report. (R)
lattr.multicol: Indicates whether or not multiple columns are used when more than one layout fits on a line. Possible values are: MULTICOL_NONE Normal output; no columns are used. MULTICOL_ORDER_HORIZONTAL Output is arranged in multiple columns, ordered horizontally. For example: rec_1 rec_2 rec_3 rec_4 rec_5 rec_6 MULTICOL_ORDER_VERTICAL Output is arranged in multiple columns, ordered vertically (per page). For example: rec_1 rec_3 rec_5 rec_2 rec_4 rec_6 (R/W)
lattr.multicol.count: Specifies the number of columns to use when multiple columns are specified (see lattr.multicol). The default value is 0. In this case, the report manager calculates the number of columns based of the report width and the layout width. (R/W)
lattr.multicol.repeat: A boolean indicating whether headers and footers are automatically repeated for each column. The default value is true. The width of the header and footer layouts width must be equal to or less than the width of the detail layout. (R/W)
lattr.print: Indicates whether or not a layout is to be printed. (R/W)
lattr.prline: After expansion of a variable in a report, this is filled with the text line that is printed. (R/W)
lattr.recordtimes: Indicates the number of times the layout will be printed. (R/W)
lattr.textexpand: A boolean indicating whether or not variables included in text fields can be expanded. The default is false. (R/W)
lattr.textlang$: The language code for printing text. The default is the language code of the report. (R/W)
lattr.textline: A string containing the source text line from the text manager. (R)
lattr.textlineno: The number of the line that must be printed. (R)
lattr.textlines.max: The maximum number of lines in the layout. (R/W)
lattr.textlines.min: The minimum number of lines in the layout. (R/W)
